verdict.rationale: Fireflies' MCP tooling includes a documented multi-item write operation: fireflies_move_meeting moves meetings to a channel or folder, but only up to 5 at a time. The transcripts list query and AskFred's cross-meeting search are bulk reads, not bulk operations. Sharing with up to 100 recipients acts on a single meeting, not many items. missing for 10: bulk operations beyond moving 5 meetings (e.g., bulk delete/share/tag across many meetings), batch API mutations, higher batch limits, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: fireflies_move_meeting - Move meetings to a channel/folder (up to 5 at a time)
some are read-only while others allow you to take actions like sharing meetings or creating soundbites.
